name: clinic-protocol-json-assessment
description: Use when a task asks for a protocol-bound clinical decision-support result over a synthetic FHIR-like clinic runtime and requires returning a single strict-schema JSON object that conforms to a provided answer_template.json (e.g. respiratory/CAP triage, pediatric head-injury triage, potassium repletion, care-management routing, or observation-window retrieval). Covers how to read the record, apply the matching protocol, filter distractors, and emit exactly the required JSON. Not for free-text clinical advice or tasks without a fixed answer template.
